Subject: SOC 2 & security requirements — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so your team and mine are aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- Need SOC 2 readiness evidence (Type II preferred) for upcoming vendor review in Jan.
- Detailed audit / access logs for API usage (7+ months retention requirement called out by compliance).
- Data retention & deletion policy: records retention window (7 years) and ability to scope retention by dataset.
- DPA & contract-level requirements: standard privacy terms + security annex and pen test evidence.
- Network segmentation and architecture diagram for prod environment for internal audit.

Goals / timeline:
- Target decision timeline: procurement loop opens mid-Jan; security review complete by end of Jan.
- Deliverables Acme needs from Redwood by 2026-12-15 to feed into internal review: SOC 2 report (or SOC-ready artifacts), current pen test summary, retention policy statement, example audit log export.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
1) Marissa: Send consolidated list of required artifacts and sample audit export (attached). ETA: EOD 12/05.
2) Acme: Confirm which recipients will validate docs (security + procurement) and share any additional questionnaire items. ETA: 12/07.
3) Neha: Prepare pricing / procurement checklist and draft mutual action plan (MAP) once security scope confirmed. ETA: 12/09.
4) Schedule 30m follow-up with Acme security (Rishi to join). Proposed times: 12/08 or 12/09.

Attachments: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (you attached during the call) — I included a short SOC2 artifact checklist for clarity.

If that looks right, I can get the SOC2 materials and the sample audit export over today.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the detailed recap — that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications and updates from our side:
- Procurement will definitely want the SOC 2 Type II if available; if not, the most recent SOC 2 readiness report + evidence is acceptable for initial review.
- For audit logs, our compliance team needs structured exports that include: timestamp, user/service principal, request path, response code, and associated model/version. Seven months retention is the minimum.
- Pen test evidence: a summary report and the date/scope of the test is ideal; we can accept redacted reports if needed.

I've attached the internal security questionnaire (Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) and a short spreadsheet listing our primary reviewers: Myself (security), Tom Reynolds (procurement), and Legal (procurement@acmehealth.com).

We can do 12/08 at 10:00am PT for the follow-up; Tom will join. If Rishi can make that, great — please confirm.

Olivia

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the questionnaire. A couple quick notes from Redwood security to help speed review:
- Audit logs: we can provide per-tenant, time-indexed CSV exports and an API endpoint for on-demand exports. We'll include sample output with the export we send.
- Retention: configurable at the account level; default is 365 days but we can accommodate 7 months (and policy text will be provided).
- Pen test: our most recent engagement was 2026-09-10; we will share the executive summary and MTR (mitigation tracking) document. Full reports are typically shared under NDA / redaction.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA + security annex; we'll attach a draft prior to the call. Please send any non-standard clauses Legal requires and we'll surface them to our counsel.

For the 12/08 call, I'll prepare:
- Network diagram + segmentation notes
- Sample audit export (CSV)
- SOC2 artifact checklist and pen test executive summary

See you on 12/08 at 10:00am PT.
